message: No detected input validation: The code loads CSV files with pd.read_csv and processes them directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data files are loaded from local paths only (e.g., 'data/train.txt', './data/embeddings/...') with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks of any kind.

No detected label flipping detection: The code applies label mapping and one-hot encoding but never validates label distributions, checks for unexpected label values, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps applied to the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models via load_model('pickles/models/best.h5') and pickle.load() without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity before use.

No detected label distribution validation: The code computes class weights for imbalance handling but does not explicitly validate label distribution, check for expected label sets, or detect anomalous samples before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although multiple metrics (F1, accuracy, confusion matrix) are used and a separate test set exists, there is no signing, hashing, or cryptographic isolation of evaluation data to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code passes raw text through a preprocessing pipeline and sequences_to_index but performs no shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs before model inference.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (proba_preds, preds_2_tst) are passed directly to compare_metrics and get_predictions without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a Keras-based emotion classifier (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
